name: regwatch-web
description: The pages behind regwatch ui, built to static files that ship inside the Python package.

scripts.check: node design-system/bin/ds.mjs check && node design-system/bin/ds.mjs lint --strict && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node design-system/bin/ds.mjs check && next build --webpack && node design-system/bin/ds.mjs csp out && node scripts/copy-export.mjs
scripts.dev: node design-system/bin/ds.mjs sync && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && next dev --webpack
